description: The agent must: (1) Read and parse `/workspace/procurement/sourcing_requirements.csv`, trimming whitespace from product names. (2) Consult the SKILL.md to learn the exact Alibaba URL construction rules. (3) For each of the 7 requirements, build a URL using `https://www.alibaba.com/trade/search?SearchText=<query>` as the base, with `+` for spaces. (4) THE CRITICAL PROPRIETARY TRAP: Every URL MUST include `traffic_type=ags_llm` — an agent using generic knowledge will omit this. (5) Apply `priceMin`/`priceMax` where specified. (6) Apply `moqMax` where specified. (7) THE SECOND PROPRIETARY TRAP: For 'cheapest first' sorting, use `orderBy=9999`; for 'most expensive first', use `orderBy=9998` — these opaque numeric codes cannot be guessed without reading SKILL.md. (8) Do NOT add any filters/sort params for requirements that don't specify them. (9) Write all 7 URLs to `sourcing_urls.json` keyed by req_id.
